cpu_systems.identity: bevy_ecs system span field `name` plus schedule span field `name`
cpu_systems.overlap: System span wall times may overlap across threads. They are not summed into a frame gap.

method.age_frames: 0 when the stamp is at or after the previous observer instant; 1 when the stamp predates it
method.common_overhead: trace, trace_chrome (includes bevy debug), chrome layer, RenderDiagnosticsPlugin, subscriber callbacks, and diagnostic sample copy on OFF and ON are not claimed as sink overhead
method.dedupe: (path, measurement_ns from that stamp); a cached stamp is not a second invocation
method.diagnostic_time: DiagnosticMeasurement.time is the PreUpdate sync stamp, not the GPU execution time
method.schedule: global stack of bevy_ecs schedule spans; PipelinedRenderingPlugin disabled at setup so only one schedule is active while workers run
method.sink: span vec push only while sink is open; RenderDiagnosticsPlugin and the subscriber stay up for all four windows
method.span_elapsed: enter Instant to exit Instant; bevy system spans are long-lived and re-entered, so tracing on_close is the process-lifetime drop and is not the per-invocation sample
method.tracing_parent: system spans are created with parent: None, so tracing parent id is expected null
